description: Bounded Ispell hash-selected dictionary collision-chain lookup, without normalization or tree fallback.

pinned_source.license: Explicit modified source/binary redistribution permission in lookup.c; full conditions and notice in LICENSE.txt.

pinned_launcher.scope_note: Profiles only lookup.c::lookup with dotree disabled and pre-normalized canonical ASCII words; excludes dictionary file parsing, capitalization/affix normalization, tree fallback, spellchecking, and CLI/file behavior.

contract.input_layout: [table_size, query_length, entry_count, query_bytes[query_length], bucket_heads[table_size], next[entry_count], word_lengths[entry_count], concatenated_entry_word_bytes]
contract.alphabet: All query and entry bytes are lowercase ASCII a-z; the caller-normalization stage is excluded.
contract.hash: Ispell 32-bit hash of ASCII-uppercase key bytes: pack first four bytes in order, then rotate left five and XOR each remaining byte; bucket is unsigned state modulo table_size.
contract.chain_invariants: Each entry index occurs exactly once across the bucket chains, next/head values are -1 or valid indexes, chains are acyclic, and every word hashes to the bucket containing it.
contract.result: One-based serialized entry index of the first exact query match in its selected bucket chain; zero if absent.

input.encoding: [table_size, query_length, entry_count, query bytes, bucket heads, next links, word lengths, concatenated word bytes]

output.meaning: One-based matching entry index, or zero when the source chain has no exact match.
